description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys signed S Juanyeh Thomas.
items.impact: Thomas returns to where he began his career. He joined Dallas as an undrafted free agent and played in 36 games from 2022-2025.
items.title: Juanyeh Thomas signs with Cowboys

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens hosted veteran G/C Graham Glasgow for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: Baltimore is looking to add depth to its offensive line.
items.title: Graham Glasgow works out for Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers hosted veteran G Kevin Zeitler for a visit on Tuesday.
items.impact: Green Bay is looking to address its banged up offensive line.
items.title: Kevin Zeitler visits Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys signed CB Alex Austin.

items.title: Alex Austin signs with Cowboys

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed WR Dante Pettis.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers hosted WR Brenden Rice for a workout.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Cowboys D/ST allowed 34 points while failing to record a sack or force any turnovers in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
items.impact: Dallas couldn't slow down Lamar Jackson or Derrick Henry in the high-scoring loss in Rio de Janeiro. The Cowboys will look to bounce back in Week 4 in a much more favorable matchup against the Texans.
items.title: Cowboys D/ST struggles in Week 3 loss
